description.value:
Your eidolon prepares itself to exemplify some ancient profane edict. It gains one of the following effects depending on its current shape, which gives Malice Incarnate additional traits:

  • Cruel Majesty (mental, visual) Requirements your eidolon is not in its true shape; Effect Your eidolon Changes Shape into its true form in a display that is equal parts terrifying and majestic. Creatures within 30 feet of your eidolon must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC.

    Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

    Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your eidolon's next Strike before the end of your turn.

    Failure The creature is off-guard for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

    Critical Failure As failure except the creature is frightened 2.

  • Malefic Consumption (morph) Requirements your eidolon is in its true form; Effect For 1 minute, your eidolon can use the Swallow Whole ability on creatures of its size or smaller that it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}. A swallowed creature takes @Damage[(4+floor((@actor.level-7)/2))d6[bludgeoning]] damage and the eidolon has a rupture value of [[/r 17+3*floor((@actor.level-7)/2)]]. At 9th level and every two levels thereafter, increase the bludgeoning damage by 1d6 and the rupture value by 3. (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.summons-unleashed.Item.VlaPbCDskarlOSkA]{Effect: Malefic Consumption})
